freeze_note: scientific implementation unchanged; R5 paths target files provisioned from inside a QS training container onto the authoritative tidal-alsh-hilab dataset/diandian mount after Trial 1882455 proved that the Singapore /newcpfs path was not the same data plane

carrier.name: BoolQ labeled train+validation
carrier.canonicalization: train rows then validation rows; keys answer,passage,question,source_index,source_split; json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False); one LF per row
carrier.gold_evaluator: exact boolean equality between delivered Yes vote and BoolQ answer; call-graph isolated from PromptTask/acquisition/stopping and invoked only after both paired TEST decisions are append-only and hash-sealed (not a separate-process isolation claim)

allocation.method: group all 12697 rows by passage_id; within each group retain the row minimizing sha256(seed + ':within-passage:' + task_id); sort the 10144 representatives by sha256(seed + ':passage:' + passage_id); first 3000 FIT, next 3000 CAL, next 3000 TEST
allocation.shadow_method: sort TEST by sha256(seed + ':shadow:' + task_id); first 300
allocation.selected_manifest_serialization: task_id + TAB + passage_id + TAB + source_split + TAB + lowercase true|false; selected order; LF between rows; no trailing LF
allocation.shadow_manifest_serialization: selected shadow task_ids in shadow hash order; LF between rows; no trailing LF

model.snapshot_manifest_contract: exactly these 14 top-level regular files; no symlinks or other entries; only a top-level .cache directory may be ignored; ledger is LC_ALL=C filename order with one '<sha256><two spaces><basename>\n' line per file, including final LF

inference.image_tag_caveat: the literal vllm017.latest tag is mutable-looking; record the literal tag, QS image ID, API date, runtime package versions, GPU UUID/name, and driver rather than claiming digest-level immutability
inference.prompt_length_gate: fail closed unless every selected rendered input_tokens + max_tokens <= max_model_len; record empirical min/median/p90/p95/p99/p99.9/max
inference.request_seed: nonnegative signed-int32-compatible value: first 8 hex digits of sha256(allocation_seed + NUL + task_id + NUL + episode_id + NUL + rollout_index), masked with 0x7fffffff; distinct episode IDs namespace FIT/CAL/TEST and FULL/BAYES; shadow uses the preassigned BAYES suffix indices; per-task FULL/BAYES seed sets must be disjoint, while any global collisions across different prompts are reported rather than treated as dependence

prompt.system: Answer the question from the passage. Output exactly one word: Yes or No.

inference.parser: case-insensitive first whole word among yes/no; Yes iff that first canonical word is yes, otherwise No; strict_compliant iff stripped output is exactly yes or no
inference.vote_semantics: parsed Yes is 1 and parsed No is 0; the policy-visible PromptTask and acquisition/stopping call graph contain no gold field

policy.name: BAYES-H-online
policy.theory_binding: Z_i=1 iff rollout i parses to Yes; x_k=sum_{i<=k} Z_i; K=x_N; MV(k)=1{x_k>k/2}; ties are No. This is a new Yes-vote carrier and does not reuse old pass/fail H or tables.
policy.fit_prior: empirical histogram of full-N Yes-vote counts on FIT
policy.unsupported_state: if posterior denominator is zero, do not stop and continue to FULL-N

calibration_family.loss: exact DP replay flip g_r(K) evaluated from each complete CAL count K
calibration_family.bound: empirical Bernstein at delta_cal; no multiplicity division because J=1

policy.cal_gate: the alpha=0.05 FIT-frozen BAYES-H rule must have CAL empirical-Bernstein UCB <=0.05; otherwise terminate before TEST
policy.arm_order: sort TEST by a dedicated outcome-blind hash; exactly 1500 tasks FULL-N first and 1500 BAYES-H-online first; independent arm seed namespaces
policy.shadow: for the frozen 10% subset only, defer continuation until every FULL-N and BAYES-H TEST primary decision is append-only/hash-sealed and the global all_test_primary_decisions_sealed marker is written; then continue the same BAYES-H trajectory/seed suffix to N; every continuation row is excluded_from_primary_cost=true

primary_analysis.correctness: paired TEST difference accuracy(BAYES-H-online)-accuracy(FULL-N); one-sided 95% task bootstrap lower bound; noninferiority margin -0.02
primary_analysis.cost: paired completed output-token reduction with 95% bootstrap interval; also report input tokens, request count, time to final answer, TTFT, and GPU/server metadata
primary_analysis.agreement: shadow prefix answer versus same-episode continued full-N vote; secondary only
primary_analysis.causality: each stop may reference only completed primary rollout rows whose response_arrival_monotonic_ns <= decision_monotonic_ns; UTC wall timestamps are recorded separately and never used for ordering
primary_analysis.forced_choice_limitation: max_tokens=4 and forced Yes/No make output-token savings close to request-count savings; input tokens, request count, and latency must be reported and TTFT is not presumed to improve

execution.global_test_primary_seal: locks/all_test_primary_decisions_sealed.json; contains a hash of all 6000 TEST decision seals and a monotonic seal timestamp; every shadow dispatch must be later
execution.gold_manifest_materialization: expected selected/split hashes are verified in memory during preflight; gold-bearing TSVs are written only post-TEST after both decisions for every pair are hash-sealed
